verses.text: Tato ay mach mak'b'ilpoj snholob' sk'e'en, ma ik'b'ilel swinakil chi', max yal-laj yoch t'a skal heb' yetisraelal ayik molanek' heb' yik'ancha'anh Jehová.
Hanheja' junok mitz' unin, malaj pax yalan yik yoch t'a skal heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová. Hanhejtona' pax yinhtilal t'a b'ak'inh max yalpaxlaj yochi.
Ha heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita, jun'elnhej malaj yalan yik heb' yoch t'a skal b'aj molanek' heb' schonhab' Jehová, ma yinhtilal heb' t'a b'ak'inh.

Yujto ayik ix honh ek'ta t'a yol smakb'en heb', ayik ix honh elta t'a Egipto, maj yak'laj jab'ok ha' heb' kuk'ej, maj yak'paxlaj jab'ok ko wa'el heb'. Ha tas ix sk'ulej heb' to ix stup winhaj Balaam yuninal winhaj Beor heb', ix kot winh t'a Petor t'a yol yik Mesopotamia, yik tzul honh skatab'ankan winh.

Haxo Jehová ko Diosal, maj schalaj yab' tas ix yal winhaj Balaam chi', yuj chi' ha katab' ijan ix yalkan winh chi' t'a kib'anh, wach' lolonel ix aj yalankan winh, yujto te xajan honh yuj Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' jun'elnhej malajokab' b'ak'inh tzex och t'a junk'olal yet' heb'. Manh he b'opax tas yuj swach'ilok heb'.
Palta haxo pax heb' edomita, manh he patikejkanel heb', yujto ayto ku'uj ko b'a yet' heb'. Manh he patikejpaxel heb' aj Egipto, yujto ek'nak honh kajan jun pekti' t'a yol smakb'en heb'.
Hato heb' yixchikin heb' ayxo yalan yik yoch t'a ko kal b'aj sko molb'ej ko b'a yuj kik'ancha'anh Jehová.
Ayik tzex b'at t'a owal yet' heb' heyajk'o'ol, ayik ayex ek' ta', manh he k'ulej tas chakb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Tato ay junok winh winak tz'el yinhatil ayik waynak, yowalil tz'elkan winh t'a spatiktak campamento tzek' k'u.
Haxo t'a yemk'uhalil, wach' syutej winh sb'ikanel sb'a, haxo yik sk'ik'b'i, tz'ochxikan winh t'a yol campamento chi'.
Yowalil junnhej junok b'aj t'a spatikel campamento b'aj tzex tzaji.
Ayik tzex b'at tzajel, tzeyik'b'at junok te te' t'a yol he pa, pach yaj snhi' te', tze joy junok olan, tzex tzaji'em t'a yo'ol. Slajwi chi', tzeyak'ankank'e lum lum t'a yib'anh.

Yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ajun heyet'ok, yiknhej yaj jun campamento chi'. Ha tzex tanhwani, skolwajpax heyet'ok yik tzeyak'an ganar heb' heyajk'o'ol chi'. Max yal-laj to ay tas chuklaj ay t'a he kal chi', talaj tz'el Jehová chi' t'a he kal yuj jun chi'.
Tato ay junok chekab' tz'el elelal t'a spatrón, snib'ej tz'aj heyet'ok, manh heyak' meltzaj t'a spatrón chi'.
Kanokab' heyet'ok. Libre sik'lan junok chonhab' b'aj snib'ej tz'aji. Malajokab' mach stzuntzani.
Malajokab' junok winh winak, ma junok ix ix t'a ko kal syak'och sb'a ajmulal yik tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha k'e'en tumin syak' ganar junok ix ix, ma junok winh winak t'a spatik yajmulal, manh he cha yak' k'e'en heb' b'aj syak' sti' yak'an t'a Jehová, yujto ha jun b'eyb'al chi' te chakb'ilel yuj.
Ayik tzeyak'an k'e'en tumin majanil t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'an yune' k'e'en, ma yalnhej tastak, manh he k'an smajananub'al.

Ha t'a junok ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal syal he k'anan smajananub'al junok tas tzeyak' smajnej. Haxo t'a junok ketchonhab', manh he k'ana', yik wach' ol yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heyib'anh t'a sat lum lum ol heyikej chi'.
Ayik tzeyak'an he ti' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, elanhchamel tze k'anab'ajej, yujto ol sk'anb'ej Jehová chi' t'ayex. Tato max heyak'a' tz'och he mul.
Tato malaj b'aj tzeyak' he ti' t'a Jehová chi' jun, malaj b'aj syal yoch he mul.
Tato ay b'aj tzeyak' he ti' heyak'an jun, yowalil tzeyak'elk'ochi, icha wal tas tz'el t'a he k'o'ol.
Ayik tzex och t'a skal smunlajel junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he lo'an sat yuwa icha jantak snib'ej he k'o'ol he lo'ani, palta max yal-laj heyik'anb'at jab'ok t'a yol he pa.
Tato tzex och t'a skal strigo junok heb' ketchonhab', syal he k'utzanelta ixim sjolom he k'uxu', palta max yal-laj tze jochelta ixim yet' k'e'en jochlab' trigo yik tzeyik'anb'ati.
